content.short: Daimo routes deposits from any currency, chain or app into the stablecoin an application wants.
content.description: Daimo focuses on deposit conversion, routing incoming funds from whatever currency, chain or app a user starts with into the specific stablecoin an application needs. Framing the product around conversion rate rather than payment rails is telling: the metric that matters to their customers is how many users complete a deposit, not how the transfer was executed.
content.meta: Daimo routes deposits from any currency, chain or app into an application's chosen stablecoin.
